rules.description: Block reads/writes/edits of .env files and secrets/ directories
rules.reason: Access to sensitive path "{path}" is prohibited. Use an environment variable mock injected via the test harness instead.

rules.description: Block edits to system core configuration
rules.reason: Modification of system core configuration "{path}" requires human escalation.
Recursive deletion of "/" is never permitted.

rules.description: Enforce bun when bun.lockb is present
rules.reason: bun.lockb is present; use "bun install" instead of npm.

rules.description: Block git commit when the working tree has whitespace errors
rules.reason: Whitespace errors detected. Run "git diff --check" and fix them before committing.
